message.abstract: <jats:p>Prophecy variables were introduced in the article “The Existence of Refinement Mappings” by Abadi and Lamport. They were difficult to use in practice. We describe a new kind of prophecy variable that we find much easier to use. We also reformulate ideas from that article in a more mathematical way.</jats:p>
title: Prophecy Made Simple
